Name: MANUAL_MAP_PATTERN_INFO_ST
Description: Hand-made map patterns. Each pattern is a header row (Row Type 0: play areas and night bosses) followed by site rows (Row Type 1: which small-base map goes on which attach point) and flag rows (Row Type 2: event flags and modifiers), all sharing the Pattern ID.

Fields.Name: Disable Param - Network Test
Fields.Description: Set: the row is left out of the network test build. Retail: set on 1139 rows.

Fields.Name: Pattern ID
Fields.Description: The pattern this row belongs to; the header row's own ID. Retail: 544 patterns.

Fields.Name: Row Type
Fields.Description: 0: the pattern's header (play areas, night bosses). 1: a site (attach point, small-base map, variation, invaders). 2: event flags and modifiers.

Fields.Name: Unknown
Fields.Description: Appears unused by the game. Retail 0 on every row.

Fields.Name: Is Invasion Site
Fields.Description: Row Type 1: set: this site gets the invaders in Invasion NPC 1 and 2. At most two sites per pattern get invaders; further flagged sites are ignored. Retail: set on every site row with an invader.

Fields.Name: Night 1 Play Area ID
Fields.Description: Header rows: the play area of night 1.

Fields.Name: Night 2 Play Area ID
Fields.Description: Header rows: the play area of night 2.

Fields.Name: Attach Point ID
Fields.Description: Site rows: the attach point the small-base map is placed on.

Fields.Name: Small Base Map ID
Fields.Description: Site rows: the small-base map placed at the attach point.

Fields.Name: Map Index
Fields.Description: Site rows: which of the small-base map's alternative maps is used (as LotResultSmallBaseAndSpot's Map Index). Retail 0-9.

Fields.Name: Variation ID
Fields.Description: Site rows: the small-base map's variation (as LotResultSmallBaseAndSpot's Variation ID). Retail 0-9.

Fields.Name: Event Flag 1
Fields.Description: Row Type 2: event flag of pair 1, applied with Modifier ID 1 like a LotResultMapPatternFlag row of the pattern (e.g. 7600-7605 Shifting Earth). 0: none.

Fields.Name: Event Flag 2
Fields.Description: Row Type 2: event flag of pair 2, applied with Modifier ID 2. 0: none.

Fields.Name: Event Flag 3
Fields.Description: Row Type 2: event flag of pair 3, applied with Modifier ID 3. 0: none.

Fields.Name: Event Flag 4
Fields.Description: Row Type 2: event flag of pair 4, applied with Modifier ID 4. 0: none.

Fields.Name: Event Flag 5
Fields.Description: Row Type 2: event flag of pair 5, applied with Modifier ID 5. 0: none.

Fields.Name: Event Flag 6
Fields.Description: Row Type 2: event flag of pair 6, applied with Modifier ID 6. 0: none.

Fields.Name: Event Flag 7
Fields.Description: Row Type 2: event flag of pair 7, applied with Modifier ID 7. 0: none.

Fields.Name: Event Flag 8
Fields.Description: Row Type 2: event flag of pair 8, applied with Modifier ID 8. 0: none.

Fields.Name: Modifier ID 1
Fields.Description: Row Type 2: modifier of pair 1; it joins the pattern's active modifiers (e.g. 14 Great Hollow, 120). A pair with Event Flag 1 and this both 0 is skipped. 0: none.

Fields.Name: Modifier ID 2
Fields.Description: Row Type 2: modifier of pair 2 (with Event Flag 2), as Modifier ID 1. Retail: 13000 (Great Hollow start point), 1100, 800 (Buried Treasure Map set).

Fields.Name: Modifier ID 3
Fields.Description: Row Type 2: modifier of pair 3, as Modifier ID 1. Retail: 704 on 2 rows.

Fields.Name: Modifier ID 4
Fields.Description: Row Type 2: modifier of pair 4, as Modifier ID 1. Retail 0 on every row.

Fields.Name: Modifier ID 5
Fields.Description: Row Type 2: modifier of pair 5, as Modifier ID 1. Retail 0 on every row.

Fields.Name: Modifier ID 6
Fields.Description: Row Type 2: modifier of pair 6, as Modifier ID 1. Retail 0 on every row.

Fields.Name: Modifier ID 7
Fields.Description: Row Type 2: modifier of pair 7, as Modifier ID 1. Retail 0 on every row.

Fields.Name: Modifier ID 8
Fields.Description: Row Type 2: modifier of pair 8, as Modifier ID 1. Retail 0 on every row.

Fields.Name: Night 1 Boss ID
Fields.Description: Header rows: the night 1 boss.

Fields.Name: Night 2 Boss ID
Fields.Description: Header rows: the night 2 boss.

Fields.Name: Invasion NPC 1
Fields.Description: Site rows: an invading NPC placed with this site.

Fields.Name: Invasion NPC 2
Fields.Description: Site rows: a second invading NPC placed with this site.

Fields.Name: Extra Night 1 Boss ID
Fields.Description: Header rows: an extra night 1 boss. Retail: set on 17 headers.

Fields.Name: Extra Night 2 Boss ID
Fields.Description: Header rows: an extra night 2 boss.
